BiblicalUsage: Bathar means to cut in two, to divide, and Abram cuts the animals of the covenant in half and lays each piece against the other before the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the divided animals are the covenant itself, because God passes between the pieces and binds Himself to His promise.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
